snippet.title: Rue Valley is out now!
snippet.description:
Today is a special day for us at Owlcat Games, because we have just released Rue Valley. This narrative RPG, inspired by games like Disco Elysium and classic Lucas Arts adventures, was developed by Emotion Spark Studio, and we helped them along the way as a publisher.
Enjoy this trailer with us!

Support @emotionsparkstudio by subscribing to their channel!

“House Of The Rising Sun”
Performed by Ross Fortune, Olugbenga Adelekan
Written by Traditional (public domain)
Music Supervisor: Irma de Wind

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126190/Rue_Valley/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/rue_valley
EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/rue-valley-48a101
Xbox Store: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pjmhlrct0j2
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014770/
